# PoC fixtures

Kept from the removed `poc/` folder. They are only parsed and scanned, never loaded
outside `scan()` (the clean pickle is loaded through `safe_load`'s restricted
unpickler).

| file | what it is | expected |
|---|---|---|
| `clean_model.pkl` | a plain dict of built-in types | CLEAN |
| `clean_model.keras` | a Sequential model really saved by Keras | CLEAN |
| `evil_custom_object.keras` | `registered_name` and a module outside Keras | SUSPICIOUS |
| `evil_lambda.keras` | Lambda bytecode from another CPython version; regression for DECISIONS C15 (the layout check rejects it before it runs) | MALICIOUS |

The marker equivalents of the removed pickle samples are generated by
`tests/corpus/build_corpus.py` (`p_os_system`, `p_open_write`, `p_socket_loopback`).
